messages:
sam (Acme): hey team — can we onboard nightjar-9b for our customer chat product? Need both hosted and dedicated options. SLO: p95 < 120ms for typical 512 seqs. Priority: cost reduction via quant (4-bit if viable). Delivery target next Tue. model artifact on s3. Any immediate blockers?
marta (ML Eng): Ack. Quick questions: is the model public or private? Can you share sample prompt distribution and target QPS? pinging @ajay @lucy to triage. Also please fill the onboarding checklist if you can: https://redwood.internal/checklists/model-onboard
ajay (InferOps): hi — two quick clarifiers: sustained QPS vs burst? seq length distribution? Also need artifact links (model + tokenizer) and preferred quant path (GPTQ vs PTQ/QLoRA). For dedicated we need inference profile (batching tolerance).
sam (Acme): seq len: 512 max, avg ~120 tokens. burst ~60 qps, sustained ~12–15 qps. Artifact: s3://acme-models/nightjar-9b/v1/model.safetensors (private). Tokenizer: s3://acme-models/nightjar-9b/v1/tokenizer.json. Private deployment required (customer data). NDA already signed.
lucy (Solutions Eng): I can run the evaluation harness (chat-smoke-v2 + safety/reg checks). Please drop ~500 sample prompts (anonymized) or give read access to the bucket. I'll also run our prompt-sensitivity suite and perplexity baselines. Example eval command I will run:
```
redwood-eval run --suite chat-smoke-v2 --model s3://acme-models/nightjar-9b/v1 --prompts s3://acme-models/nightjar-9b/v1/sample_prompts.json --output /tmp/nightjar-eval
```
marta (ML Eng): I'll reserve GPU for compatibility and quant experiments. @quant-bot can you kick a quick 4-bit GPTQ smoke to see mem/perf delta? Also note: we need to collect tokenizer edge cases before any quant.
quant-bot: Auto-quant smoke starting for nightjar-9b v1 on gpu-a100-80GB...
quant-bot: gptq-4bit run completed (approx 42m). Summary: peak GPU mem 26GB (with KV cache warmup), throughput +1.8x vs fp16 in our microbench harness, latency p95 ~110ms for 120-token sequences at batch=1. Warning: per-layer calibration failed on attention block 8 (quant precision instability) — we applied fallback (per-channel rounding) which recovered correctness but may cost a little perf. Recommend trying gptq-4bit-ct2 and a quick QAT/ptq variant if instability persists. Full logs: s3://redwood-logs/nightjar9b/quant-smoke-2715001234.log
ajay (InferOps): good data — tokenizer seems present on S3. Lucy, can you include tokenization mismatch checks? sometimes the repo has a tokenization-config.txt that changes BOS/EOS handling. If quant instability persists, we'll try bf16 mixed or qlora with 8-bit act fallback. Also suggest a canary: 5% traffic to q4 route then ramp. Rollback if p95 > 250ms.
sam (Acme): granted read to redwood-service-account on the bucket. I'll upload the 500 prompts to s3://acme-models/nightjar-9b/v1/sample_prompts.json in the next hour.
lucy (Solutions Eng): started evals — ETA EOD. Early note: in a quick pass we saw occasional hallucinated dates in long-context replies (dev-only). I'll add regression tests for that pattern.
marta (ML Eng): reserving gpu-1 for quant experiments tomorrow 09:00–11:00 PST. Booking ticket and intake checklist now. Sam — confirm NDA + bucket access (thanks).
sam (Acme): NDA done, access granted. thanks.
lucy (Solutions Eng): quick heads up — the eval harness found tokenizer mismatch on 0.3% of prompts (likely encoding differences). adding a small preproc step to normalize. Will include patch in the eval output.
ajay (InferOps): once we have eval outputs, my plan: (1) compatibility smoke, (2) quant candidates (gptq-4bit, gptq-4bit-ct2, qlora fallback), (3) latency/cost trade matrix, (4) canary plan (5% q4 then ramp). If gptq-4bit needs per-layer overrides we can pin them in the runtime profile.
marta (ML Eng): creating ticket INTK-4821 with checklist + canary config + scheduled experiments. I linked the ticket here: https://redwood.internal/issue/INTK-4821 — will attach quant logs, eval outputs, and access notes.
deploy-bot: created ticket INTK-4821 and assigned to marta, ajay, lucy.
marta (ML Eng): thanks all — next update after lucy posts eval summary. :thumbsup:
